note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Whether a request is documented on the page or annotated as an inference is SUPPLIED by the author (mode, ¶, basis, note); the scene never decides what a page means and draws no legal consequence.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Same warehouse page in both scenes. A asks when the goods were collected (stated at ¶2: a copy strip is pulled onto the card); B asks when the goods reached Party B (not stated: ¶2 and ¶3 are flagged as the basis and an annotated-inference note is written).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional source (site-meeting minutes) and a one-sentence basis. A asks who presented the floor plan (stated at ¶2); B asks whether the plan was approved, which the minutes do not state: only ¶2 is flagged as the basis and the note records that the minutes are silent on approval.

sources.title: Minutes of the site meeting
sentences: The meeting opened at 10:00 on Day 12.
Party C presented the revised floor plan.
The inspection was moved to Day 15.
The minutes were circulated on Day 13.

b.label: Whether the floor plan was approved
b.note: Plan presented; approval not recorded here

scenarioA.label: Stated in the minutes
scenarioA.caption: The requested fact is written at ¶2

scenarioB.label: Not stated in the minutes
scenarioB.caption: A note records what ¶2 does and does not say

params.changedFact: Only the request differs: who presented (A) vs whether it was approved (B)

comparisonLabels.neutral: The minutes are not assessed; both entries are simply filed as they are

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long requests, note, scenario labels and captions, changed fact, shared facts and comparison labels, and long sentences.

sources.library: Case library of the district archive
sources.title: Consolidated logistics file of the northern depot
sentences: Order 118 for forty crates of ceramic tiles was placed by Party A on Day 2.
The regional carrier collected the goods from the northern depot on Day 3.
Party B's receiving clerk signed the delivery note at the loading bay on Day 4.
The invoice for the remaining crates was issued on Day 6 by the sales office.

a.label: When the regional carrier collected the goods from the depot

b.label: When the goods reached Party B's loading bay
b.note: Goods reached Party B's loading bay by Day 4 (inferred, not stated)

scenarioA.label: Documented fact from the logistics file
scenarioA.caption: The consolidated page states exactly what was requested

scenarioB.label: Annotated inference with its basis
scenarioB.caption: The page does not state it; the note names the sentences it rests on

params.changedFact: Only the typed request differs: the page states the answer in scenario A but not in scenario B

comparisonLabels.guide: Changed fact: what the user asked the file for
comparisonLabels.neutral: Both entries stay on the card exactly as written; nothing is concluded from either of them

b.label: Cuándo llegó la mercancía a la parte B
b.note: La mercancía llegó a la parte B hacia el día 4
